This is the #1 any tip that should beat them all.

  • Even if you are paying cash.

  • Even if your loan doesn't require it.

  • If you live in an area with historical flooding (New Orleans or hurricaine country) get mold tests done.

  • Leave no stone unturned. Go to city hall and ask about any cracking, or any natural gas pipelines in the area.   • Once you have a specific place in mind, call and speak to someone about flood insurance - it's a federal program so they can't dick you down with rates or lie about the flood potential with your house/property.
